edges.mechanism: Frequently co-formulated (collagen II/HA/chondroitin matrices, HA matrix ingredients); both target dermal/joint extracellular matrix. In UV-exposed mice, adding collagen at 12-fold dose gave no benefit beyond oral HA alone.
edges.evidence: Combination RCT in OA (BioCell, n=80) and open-label skin study; mouse photoaging study; additive effect in humans not isolated; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Glucosamine/N-acetylglucosamine is a biosynthetic substrate for HA; combined liquid products (HA + glucosamine + chondroitin) are marketed for knee OA.
edges.evidence: Two small RCTs of the combination: positive in mild knee pain, null in moderate pain; no factorial trial isolating HA; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Claimed synergy via vitamin C's role in collagen synthesis alongside HA; evidence limited to multi-ingredient products and animal wound data.
edges.evidence: Uncontrolled 40-day study of an HA + vitamin C/biotin/Cu/Zn drink (n=20); rat wound model with topical HA + oral vitamin C; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Fixed EGCG + folate + B12 + HA (50 mg) tablet studied for HPV clearance; HA's individual contribution unknown.
edges.evidence: Single uncontrolled clinical study (n=106); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: No interaction with oral HA described. Relevant to injected HA: bruising/bleeding at injection sites; joint injections at therapeutic INR and on DOACs/antiplatelets showed very low bleeding rates.
edges.evidence: Retrospective (640 procedures) and prospective (5080 procedures) cohort data for joint injections; filler bruising commentary; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Antiplatelet use around injected HA (IA/fillers) may add to bruising, though injection cohorts on antiplatelets reported no significant bleeding; aspirin is also used in filler vascular-occlusion rescue protocols. No interaction with oral HA.
edges.evidence: Prospective injection cohort; systematic review of ocular filler complications; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Enzyme that degrades HA; used to dissolve HA fillers and treat vascular occlusion. Allergy risk (higher with bee/wasp venom allergy); retrobulbar use for filler blindness is controversial.
edges.evidence: Practice guidelines and consensus statements; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oral HA absorption depends on gut Bacteroides degrading it to absorbable oligosaccharides; germ-free mice absorbed almost none, so broad-spectrum antibiotics could theoretically blunt uptake/effect.
edges.evidence: Mouse 13C-tracer and rat absorption studies only; no human data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oral full-spectrum HA reduced rescue NSAID/analgesic use in knee OA; IA HA meta-analyses often allowed concomitant NSAIDs.
edges.evidence: Single small RCT (n=60) plus IA safety MA; low certainty

edges.mechanism: HA-chondroitin bioadhesive (Esoxx) provides mucosal protection added to acid suppression in non-erosive reflux disease.
edges.evidence: Multicentre double-blind RCT (n=154): 52.6% vs 32.1% responders; moderate certainty for that product only

edges.mechanism: Context: IA HA combined with IA corticosteroid had the largest modelled WOMAC pain effect; triamcinolone alone ranked best short-term in large-trial NMA.
edges.evidence: Model-based MA (168 studies) and NMA of large RCTs; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Context (fillers): systemic immune activation can trigger delayed inflammatory reactions/angioedema in previously placed HA fillers.
edges.evidence: Case reports/series and consensus on late-onset reactions; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Context (fillers): delayed hypersensitivity reaction in an HA filler 2 days after IV zoledronic acid (acute-phase immune activation).
edges.evidence: Single case report; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: HA/CD44 signalling promotes tumour stemness, progression and therapy resistance; HA fragments of different sizes can enhance or attenuate CD44 signalling. Conversely, high-MW HA mediates cancer resistance in naked mole-rats. No human data that oral HA affects cancer risk.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic reviews and animal data only; theoretical; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Context (fillers): active autoimmune disease is a host risk factor for late-onset filler reactions; in scleroderma/morphea, HA fillers caused mild AEs and no flares. Oral 900 kDa HA was immunomodulatory (TLR4/SOCS3) in lupus-prone mice.
edges.evidence: Consensus statement, systematic review of case series, mouse study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Rooster/chicken-comb-derived HA extracts (Hyal-Joint, Mobilee) may carry avian proteins; fermentation-derived HA avoids this source.
edges.evidence: Product descriptions in trials and production review; no oral HA anaphylaxis reports found; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Serum HA is elevated with fibrosis/cirrhosis and used diagnostically; postprandial rises are exaggerated in cirrhosis, complicating interpretation of HA-based tests.
edges.evidence: Diagnostic MA and clinical physiology study; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Serum HA rises after meals (more in cirrhosis and type 2 diabetes); oral HA has ~0.2% bioavailability in mice and no human study has tested whether supplements raise serum HA. Fasting samples and pausing supplements before testing are prudent.
edges.evidence: Clinical physiology studies and animal pharmacokinetics; theoretical for supplements; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: HA is one of three ELF components (with PIIINP, TIMP-1); any exogenous or postprandial HA rise would shift the score. Hemolysis also lowers ELF via PIIINP.
edges.evidence: Diagnostic accuracy MAs and preanalytical study; supplement effect untested; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Serum HA predicts radiographic knee OA progression; whether HA supplements alter this biomarker is unknown.
edges.evidence: 5-year cohort (n=444); supplement effect untested; very low certainty
